edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land. A man went from Bethlehem in Judah to live as a resident alien in the fields of Moab, he and his wife and his two sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּימֵי שְׁפֹט הַשֹּׁפְטִים וַיְהִי רָעָב בָּאָרֶץ וַיֵּלֶךְ אִישׁ מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה לָגוּר בִּשְׂדֵי מוֹאָב הוּא וְאִשְׁתּוֹ וּשְׁנֵי בָנָיו׃

verses.english: The man’s name was Elimelech, his wife’s name was Naomi, and the names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion. They were Ephrathites from Bethlehem in Judah. They came to the fields of Moab and were there.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁם הָאִישׁ אֱ‍לִימֶלֶךְ וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ נָעֳמִי וְשֵׁם שְׁנֵי־בָנָיו מַחְלוֹן וְכִלְיוֹן אֶפְרָתִים מִבֵּית לֶחֶם יְהוּדָה וַיָּבֹאוּ שְׂדֵי־מוֹאָב וַיִּהְיוּ־שָׁם׃

verses.english: Elimelech, Naomi’s husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אֱלִימֶלֶךְ אִישׁ נָעֳמִי וַתִּשָּׁאֵר הִיא וּשְׁנֵי בָנֶיהָ׃

verses.english: They took Moabite women as wives, one named Orpah and the other named Ruth. They lived there about ten years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂאוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מֹאֲבִיּוֹת שֵׁם הָאַחַת עָרְפָּה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִית רוּת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם כְּעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃

verses.english: Both Mahlon and Chilion also died, and the woman was left bereft of her two children and her husband.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמוּתוּ גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶם מַחְלוֹן וְכִלְיוֹן וַתִּשָּׁאֵר הָאִשָּׁה מִשְּׁנֵי יְלָדֶיהָ וּמֵאִישָׁהּ׃

verses.english: She arose with her daughters-in-law and returned from the fields of Moab, for she had heard in the field of Moab that YHWH had visited His people to give them bread.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם הִיא וְכַלֹּתֶיהָ וַתָּשָׁב מִשְּׂדֵי מוֹאָב כִּי שָׁמְעָה בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב כִּי־פָקַד יְהוָה אֶת־עַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם לָחֶם׃

verses.english: She went out from the place where she had been, with her two daughters-in-law, and they took the road to return to the land of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא מִן־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר הָיְתָה־שָׁמָּה וּשְׁתֵּי כַלֹּתֶיהָ עִמָּהּ וַתֵּלַכְנָה בַדֶּרֶךְ לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, “Go; return, each to her mother’s house. May YHWH show you steadfast kindness, as you have shown it to the dead and to me.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר נָעֳמִי לִשְׁתֵּי כַלֹּתֶיהָ לֵכְנָה שֹּׁבְנָה אִשָּׁה לְבֵית אִמָּהּ יעשה [יַעַשׂ] יְהוָה עִמָּכֶם חֶסֶד כַּאֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־הַמֵּתִים וְעִמָּדִי׃

verses.english: May YHWH grant that you find rest, each in her husband’s house.” She kissed them, and they raised their voices and wept.
verses.hebrew: יִתֵּן יְהוָה לָכֶם וּמְצֶאןָ מְנוּחָה אִשָּׁה בֵּית אִישָׁהּ וַתִּשַּׁק לָהֶן וַתִּשֶּׂאנָה קוֹלָן וַתִּבְכֶּינָה׃

verses.english: They said to her, “But we will return with you to your people.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמַרְנָה־לָּהּ כִּי־אִתָּךְ נָשׁוּב לְעַמֵּךְ׃

verses.english: Naomi said, “Return, my daughters. Why should you go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb who could become your husbands?
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר נָעֳמִי שֹׁבְנָה בְנֹתַי לָמָּה תֵלַכְנָה עִמִּי הַעוֹד־לִי בָנִים בְּמֵעַי וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לַאֲנָשִׁים׃

verses.english: Return, my daughters; go, for I am too old to have a husband. Even if I said, ‘I have hope,’ even if I had a husband tonight and even bore sons,
verses.hebrew: שֹׁבְנָה בְנֹתַי לֵכְןָ כִּי זָקַנְתִּי מִהְיוֹת לְאִישׁ כִּי אָמַרְתִּי יֶשׁ־לִי תִקְוָה גַּם הָיִיתִי הַלַּיְלָה לְאִישׁ וְגַם יָלַדְתִּי בָנִים׃

verses.english: would you wait for them until they grew up? Would you shut yourselves away for them, without having a husband? No, my daughters. It is far more bitter for me than for you, for YHWH’s hand has gone out against me.”
verses.hebrew: הֲלָהֵן תְּשַׂבֵּרְנָה עַד אֲשֶׁר יִגְדָּלוּ הֲלָהֵן תֵּעָגֵנָה לְבִלְתִּי הֱיוֹת לְאִישׁ אַל בְּנֹתַי כִּי־מַר־לִי מְאֹד מִכֶּם כִּי־יָצְאָה בִי יַד־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: They raised their voices and wept again. Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth clung to her.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשֶּׂנָה קוֹלָן וַתִּבְכֶּינָה עוֹד וַתִּשַּׁק עָרְפָּה לַחֲמוֹתָהּ וְרוּת דָּבְקָה בָּהּ׃

verses.english: She said, “Look, your sister-in-law has returned to her people and to her gods. Return after your sister-in-law.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה שָׁבָה יְבִמְתֵּךְ אֶל־עַמָּהּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֶיהָ שׁוּבִי אַחֲרֵי יְבִמְתֵּךְ׃

verses.english: Ruth said, “Do not press me to leave you and turn back from following you. Where you go, I will go, and where you lodge, I will lodge. Your people are my people, and your God is my God.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רוּת אַל־תִּפְגְּעִי־בִי לְעָזְבֵךְ לָשׁוּב מֵאַחֲרָיִךְ כִּי אֶל־אֲשֶׁר תֵּלְכִי אֵלֵךְ וּבַאֲשֶׁר תָּלִינִי אָלִין עַמֵּךְ עַמִּי וֵאלֹהַיִךְ אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May YHWH do this to me, and add more, for death will separate me and you.”
verses.hebrew: בַּאֲשֶׁר תָּמוּתִי אָמוּת וְשָׁם אֶקָּבֵר כֹּה יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה לִי וְכֹה יֹסִיף כִּי הַמָּוֶת יַפְרִיד בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵךְ׃

verses.english: When she saw that she was determined to go with her, she stopped speaking to her.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא כִּי־מִתְאַמֶּצֶת הִיא לָלֶכֶת אִתָּהּ וַתֶּחְדַּל לְדַבֵּר אֵלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: The two of them went on until they reached Bethlehem. When they entered Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women said, “Is this Naomi?”
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלַכְנָה שְׁתֵּיהֶם עַד־בֹּאָנָה בֵּית לָחֶם וַיְהִי כְּבֹאָנָה בֵּית לֶחֶם וַתֵּהֹם כָּל־הָעִיר עֲלֵיהֶן וַתֹּאמַרְנָה הֲזֹאת נָעֳמִי׃

verses.english: She said to them, “Do not call me Naomi; call me Mara, for Shaddai has dealt very bitterly with me.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶן אַל־תִּקְרֶאנָה לִי נָעֳמִי קְרֶאןָ לִי מָרָא כִּי־הֵמַר שַׁדַּי לִי מְאֹד׃

verses.english: I went away full, but YHWH has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi, when YHWH has testified against me and Shaddai has brought calamity upon me?”
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי מְלֵאָה הָלַכְתִּי וְרֵיקָם הֱשִׁיבַנִי יְהוָה לָמָּה תִקְרֶאנָה לִי נָעֳמִי וַיהוָה עָנָה בִי וְשַׁדַּי הֵרַע לִי׃

verses.english: So Naomi returned, with Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, who came back from the fields of Moab. They reached Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּשָׁב נָעֳמִי וְרוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה כַלָּתָהּ עִמָּהּ הַשָּׁבָה מִשְּׂדֵי מוֹאָב וְהֵמָּה בָּאוּ בֵּית לֶחֶם בִּתְחִלַּת קְצִיר שְׂעֹרִים׃

verses.english: Naomi had a kinsman of her husband, a man of great standing from Elimelech’s clan, whose name was Boaz.
verses.hebrew: וּלְנָעֳמִי מידע [מוֹדַע] לְאִישָׁהּ אִישׁ גִּבּוֹר חַיִל מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת אֱלִימֶלֶךְ וּשְׁמוֹ בֹּעַז׃

verses.english: Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, “Please let me go to the field and glean among the ears of grain after someone in whose eyes I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה אֶל־נָעֳמִי אֵלְכָה־נָּא הַשָּׂדֶה וַאֲלַקֳטָּה בַשִׁבֳּלִים אַחַר אֲשֶׁר אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ לְכִי בִתִּי׃

verses.english: She went, came to the field, and gleaned behind the reapers. As it happened, she happened upon the portion of the field belonging to Boaz, who was from Elimelech’s clan.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּבוֹא וַתְּלַקֵּט בַּשָּׂדֶה אַחֲרֵי הַקֹּצְרִים וַיִּקֶר מִקְרֶהָ חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה לְבֹעַז אֲשֶׁר מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת אֱלִימֶלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Look, Boaz came from Bethlehem and said to the reapers, “YHWH be with you.” They said to him, “May YHWH bless you.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה־בֹעַז בָּא מִבֵּית לֶחֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לַקּוֹצְרִים יְהוָה עִמָּכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Boaz said to his young man who was stationed over the reapers, “Whose young woman is this?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּעַז לְנַעֲרוֹ הַנִּצָּב עַל־הַקּוֹצְרִים לְמִי הַנַּעֲרָה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: The young man stationed over the reapers answered and said, “She is a Moabite young woman who returned with Naomi from the field of Moab.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן הַנַּעַר הַנִּצָּב עַל־הַקּוֹצְרִים וַיֹּאמַר נַעֲרָה מוֹאֲבִיָּה הִיא הַשָּׁבָה עִם־נָעֳמִי מִשְּׂדֵה מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: She said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the reapers.’ She came and has remained from the morning until now; her sitting in the shelter has been little.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֲלַקֳטָה־נָּא וְאָסַפְתִּי בָעֳמָרִים אַחֲרֵי הַקּוֹצְרִים וַתָּבוֹא וַתַּעֲמוֹד מֵאָז הַבֹּקֶר וְעַד־עַתָּה זֶה שִׁבְתָּהּ הַבַּיִת מְעָט׃

verses.english: Boaz said to Ruth, “Do you not hear, my daughter? Do not go to glean in another field, and do not pass on from here. Stay close here with my young women.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּעַז אֶל־רוּת הֲלוֹא שָׁמַעַתְּ בִּתִּי אַל־תֵּלְכִי לִלְקֹט בְּשָׂדֶה אַחֵר וְגַם לֹא תַעֲבוּרִי מִזֶּה וְכֹה תִדְבָּקִין עִם־נַעֲרֹתָי׃

verses.english: Keep your eyes on the field they reap, and follow them. Have I not commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels and drink from what the young men draw.”
verses.hebrew: עֵינַיִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְצֹרוּן וְהָלַכְתִּ אַחֲרֵיהֶן הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִי אֶת־הַנְּעָרִים לְבִלְתִּי נָגְעֵךְ וְצָמִת וְהָלַכְתְּ אֶל־הַכֵּלִים וְשָׁתִית מֵאֲשֶׁר יִשְׁאֲבוּן הַנְּעָרִים׃

verses.english: She fell on her face and bowed to the ground. She said to him, “Why have I found favor in your eyes, that you should take notice of me, though I am a foreign woman?”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפֹּל עַל־פָּנֶיהָ וַתִּשְׁתַּחוּ אָרְצָה וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַדּוּעַ מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְהַכִּירֵנִי וְאָּנֹכִי נָכְרִיָּה׃

verses.english: Boaz answered and said to her, “Everything you have done for your mother-in-law after your husband’s death has been fully reported to me: you left your father, your mother, and the land of your birth, and came to a people whom you did not know before.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן בֹּעַז וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הֻגֵּד הֻגַּד לִי כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂית אֶת־חֲמוֹתֵךְ אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אִישֵׁךְ וַתַּעַזְבִי אָּבִיךְ וְאִמֵּךְ וְאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתֵּךְ וַתֵּלְכִי אֶל־עַם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדַעַתְּ תְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם׃

verses.english: May YHWH repay your deed, and may your reward be complete from YHWH, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלֵּם יְהוָה פָּעֳלֵךְ וּתְהִי מַשְׂכֻּרְתֵּךְ שְׁלֵמָה מֵעִם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־בָּאת לַחֲסוֹת תַּחַת־כְּנָפָיו׃

verses.english: She said, “May I find favor in your eyes, my lord, for you have comforted me and spoken to the heart of your slave woman, though I am not like one of your slave girls.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ אֲדֹנִי כִּי נִחַמְתָּנִי וְכִי דִבַּרְתָּ עַל־לֵב שִׁפְחָתֶךָ וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אֶהְיֶה כְּאַחַת שִׁפְחֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: At mealtime Boaz said to her, “Come here, eat some of the bread, and dip your morsel in the vinegar.” She sat beside the reapers, and he handed her parched grain. She ate, was satisfied, and had some left.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָה בֹעַז לְעֵת הָאֹכֶל גֹּשִׁי הֲלֹם וְאָכַלְתְּ מִן־הַלֶּחֶם וְטָבַלְתְּ פִּתֵּךְ בַּחֹמֶץ וַתֵּשֶׁב מִצַּד הַקּוֹצְרִים וַיִּצְבָּט־לָהּ קָלִי וַתֹּאכַל וַתִּשְׂבַּע וַתֹּתַר׃

verses.english: She arose to glean, and Boaz commanded his young men, saying, “Let her glean even among the sheaves, and do not shame her.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם לְלַקֵּט וַיְצַו בֹּעַז אֶת־נְעָרָיו לֵאמֹר גַּם בֵּין הָעֳמָרִים תְּלַקֵּט וְלֹא תַכְלִימוּהָ׃

verses.english: You must also pull some out for her from the bundles and leave it; let her glean, and do not rebuke her.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם שֹׁל־תָּשֹׁלּוּ לָהּ מִן־הַצְּבָתִים וַעֲזַבְתֶּם וְלִקְּטָה וְלֹא תִגְעֲרוּ־בָהּ׃

verses.english: She gleaned in the field until evening and beat out what she had gleaned. It was about an ephah of barley.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּלַקֵּט בַּשָּׂדֶה עַד־הָעָרֶב וַתַּחְבֹּט אֵת אֲשֶׁר־לִקֵּטָה וַיְהִי כְּאֵיפָה שְׂעֹרִים׃

verses.english: She lifted it and came into the city. Her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. She brought out and gave her what she had left after being satisfied.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂא וַתָּבוֹא הָעִיר וַתֵּרֶא חֲמוֹתָהּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־לִקֵּטָה וַתּוֹצֵא וַתִּתֶּן־לָהּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־הוֹתִרָה מִשָּׂבְעָהּ׃

verses.english: Her mother-in-law said to her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the one who took notice of you.” She told her mother-in-law with whom she had worked and said, “The name of the man with whom I worked today is Boaz.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ חֲמוֹתָהּ אֵיפֹה לִקַּטְתְּ הַיּוֹם וְאָנָה עָשִׂית יְהִי מַכִּירֵךְ בָּרוּךְ וַתַּגֵּד לַחֲמוֹתָהּ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־עָשְׂתָה עִמּוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר שֵׁם הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי עִמּוֹ הַיּוֹם בֹּעַז׃

verses.english: Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, “Blessed be he by YHWH, who has not abandoned his kindness toward the living and the dead.” Naomi said to her, “The man is close kin to us; he is one of our redeeming kinsmen.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר נָעֳמִי לְכַלָּתָהּ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לַיהוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָזַב חַסְדּוֹ אֶת־הַחַיִּים וְאֶת־הַמֵּתִים וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ נָעֳמִי קָרוֹב לָנוּ הָאִישׁ מִגֹּאֲלֵנוּ הוּא׃

verses.english: Ruth the Moabite said, “He also said to me, ‘Stay close with my young men until they have finished all my harvest.’”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר רוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה גַּם כִּי־אָמַר אֵלַי עִם־הַנְּעָרִים אֲשֶׁר־לִי תִּדְבָּקִין עַד אִם־כִּלּוּ אֵת כָּל־הַקָּצִיר אֲשֶׁר־לִי׃

verses.english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, “It is good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, so that they do not accost you in another field.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר נָעֳמִי אֶל־רוּת כַּלָּתָהּ טוֹב בִּתִּי כִּי תֵצְאִי עִם־נַעֲרוֹתָיו וְלֹא יִפְגְּעוּ־בָךְ בְּשָׂדֶה אַחֵר׃

verses.english: She stayed close to Boaz’s young women to glean until the barley harvest and the wheat harvest ended. She lived with her mother-in-law.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּדְבַּק בְּנַעֲרוֹת בֹּעַז לְלַקֵּט עַד־כְּלוֹת קְצִיר־הַשְּׂעֹרִים וּקְצִיר הַחִטִּים וַתֵּשֶׁב אֶת־חֲמוֹתָהּ׃

verses.english: Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, “My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, so that it may go well with you?
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ נָעֳמִי חֲמוֹתָהּ בִּתִּי הֲלֹא אֲבַקֶּשׁ־לָךְ מָנוֹחַ אֲשֶׁר יִיטַב־לָךְ׃

verses.english: Now, is not Boaz our kinsman, with whose young women you were? Look, he is winnowing the barley on the threshing floor tonight.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הֲלֹא בֹעַז מֹדַעְתָּנוּ אֲשֶׁר הָיִית אֶת־נַעֲרוֹתָיו הִנֵּה־הוּא זֹרֶה אֶת־גֹּרֶן הַשְּׂעֹרִים הַלָּיְלָה׃

verses.english: Wash, anoint yourself, put your garments on, and go down to the threshing floor. Do not make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.
verses.hebrew: וְרָחַצְתְּ וָסַכְתְּ וְשַׂמְתְּ שמלתך [שִׂמְלֹתַיִךְ] עָלַיִךְ וירדתי [וְיָרַדְתְּ] הַגֹּרֶן אַל־תִּוָּדְעִי לָאִישׁ עַד כַּלֹּתוֹ לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת׃

verses.english: When he lies down, notice the place where he lies. Go in, uncover the place at his feet, and lie down. He will tell you what you should do.”
verses.hebrew: וִיהִי בְשָׁכְבוֹ וְיָדַעַתְּ אֶת־הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּב־שָׁם וּבָאת וְגִלִּית מַרְגְּלֹתָיו ושכבתי [וְשָׁכָבְתְּ] וְהוּא יַגִּיד לָךְ אֵת אֲשֶׁר תַּעַשִׂין׃

verses.english: She said to her, “Everything you say to me I will do.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמְרִי [אֵלַי] אֶעֱשֶׂה׃

verses.english: She went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had commanded her.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶד הַגֹּרֶן וַתַּעַשׂ כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־צִוַּתָּה חֲמוֹתָהּ׃

verses.english: Boaz ate and drank, and his heart was glad. He went to lie down at the edge of the grain heap. She came quietly, uncovered the place at his feet, and lay down.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכַל בֹּעַז וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַיִּיטַב לִבּוֹ וַיָּבֹא לִשְׁכַּב בִּקְצֵה הָעֲרֵמָה וַתָּבֹא בַלָּט וַתְּגַל מַרְגְּלֹתָיו וַתִּשְׁכָּב׃

verses.english: At midnight the man was startled and turned over, and look, a woman was lying at his feet.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּחֱרַד הָאִישׁ וַיִּלָּפֵת וְהִנֵּה אִשָּׁה שֹׁכֶבֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָיו׃

verses.english: He said, “Who are you?” She said, “I am Ruth, your slave woman. Spread your wing over your slave woman, for you are a redeeming kinsman.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־אָתּ וַתֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי רוּת אֲמָתֶךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ כְנָפֶךָ עַל־אֲמָתְךָ כִּי גֹאֵל אָתָּה׃

verses.english: He said, “Blessed be you by YHWH, my daughter. You have made this last kindness greater than the first, by not going after young men, whether poor or rich.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בְּרוּכָה אַתְּ לַיהוָה בִּתִּי הֵיטַבְתְּ חַסְדֵּךְ הָאַחֲרוֹן מִן־הָרִאשׁוֹן לְבִלְתִּי־לֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי הַבַּחוּרִים אִם־דַּל וְאִם־עָשִׁיר׃

verses.english: Now, my daughter, do not fear. Everything you say I will do for you, for all my people at the gate know that you are a woman of worth.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בִּתִּי אַל־תִּירְאִי כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־תֹּאמְרִי אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּךְ כִּי יוֹדֵעַ כָּל־שַׁעַר עַמִּי כִּי אֵשֶׁת חַיִל אָתְּ׃

verses.english: Now, it is indeed true that I am a redeeming kinsman, but there is also a redeeming kinsman nearer than I.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּי אָמְנָם כִּי אם גֹאֵל אָנֹכִי וְגַם יֵשׁ גֹּאֵל קָרוֹב מִמֶּנִּי׃

verses.english: Stay the night. In the morning, if he will redeem you, good; let him redeem you. But if he does not wish to redeem you, I will redeem you, as YHWH lives. Lie down until morning.”
verses.hebrew: לִינִי הַלַּיְלָה וְהָיָה בַבֹּקֶר אִם־יִגְאָלֵךְ טוֹב יִגְאָל וְאִם־לֹא יַחְפֹּץ לְגָאֳלֵךְ וּגְאַלְתִּיךְ אָנֹכִי חַי־יְהוָה שִׁכְבִי עַד־הַבֹּקֶר׃

verses.english: She lay at his feet until morning and arose before a man could recognize his neighbor. He said, “Let it not be known that the woman came to the threshing floor.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁכַּב מרגלתו [מַרְגְּלוֹתָיוֹ] עַד־הַבֹּקֶר וַתָּקָם בטרום [בְּטֶרֶם] יַכִּיר אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־יִוָּדַע כִּי־בָאָה הָאִשָּׁה הַגֹּרֶן׃

verses.english: He said, “Bring the wrap you are wearing and hold it.” She held it, and he measured six measures of barley and laid it on her. He entered the city.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָבִי הַמִּטְפַּחַת אֲשֶׁר־עָלַיִךְ וְאֶחֳזִי־בָהּ וַתֹּאחֶז בָּהּ וַיָּמָד שֵׁשׁ־שְׂעֹרִים וַיָּשֶׁת עָלֶיהָ וַיָּבֹא הָעִיר׃

verses.english: She came to her mother-in-law, who said, “Who are you, my daughter?” She told her everything the man had done for her.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבוֹא אֶל־חֲמוֹתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר מִי־אַתְּ בִּתִּי וַתַּגֶּד־לָהּ אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לָהּ הָאִישׁ׃

verses.english: She said, “He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said to me, ‘Do not come empty-handed to your mother-in-law.’”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שֵׁשׁ־הַשְּׂעֹרִים הָאֵלֶּה נָתַן לִי כִּי אָמַר [אֵלַי] אַל־תָּבוֹאִי רֵיקָם אֶל־חֲמוֹתֵךְ׃

verses.english: She said, “Sit, my daughter, until you know how the matter will turn out, for the man will not rest unless he finishes the matter today.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר שְׁבִי בִתִּי עַד אֲשֶׁר תֵּדְעִין אֵיךְ יִפֹּל דָּבָר כִּי לֹא יִשְׁקֹט הָאִישׁ כִּי־אִם־כִּלָּה הַדָּבָר הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: Boaz went up to the gate and sat there. Look, the redeeming kinsman of whom Boaz had spoken was passing by. He said, “Turn aside and sit here, so-and-so.” He turned aside and sat down.
verses.hebrew: וּבֹעַז עָלָה הַשַּׁעַר וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם וְהִנֵּה הַגֹּאֵל עֹבֵר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר־בֹּעַז וַיֹּאמֶר סוּרָה שְׁבָה־פֹּה פְּלֹנִי אַלְמֹנִי וַיָּסַר וַיֵּשֵׁב׃

verses.english: He took ten men from the city’s elders and said, “Sit here.” They sat down.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מִזִּקְנֵי הָעִיר וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁבוּ־פֹה וַיֵּשֵׁבוּ׃

verses.english: He said to the redeeming kinsman, “Naomi, who returned from the field of Moab, has sold the portion of the field that belonged to our brother Elimelech.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לַגֹּאֵל חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר לְאָחִינוּ לֶאֱלִימֶלֶךְ מָכְרָה נָעֳמִי הַשָּׁבָה מִשְּׂדֵה מוֹאָב׃

verses.english: I thought I should uncover your ear, saying, ‘Acquire it before those seated here and before my people’s elders.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if he will not redeem it, tell me, so that I may know, for there is no one besides you to redeem it, and I come after you.” He said, “I will redeem it.”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אֶגְלֶה אָזְנְךָ לֵאמֹר קְנֵה נֶגֶד הַיֹּשְׁבִים וְנֶגֶד זִקְנֵי עַמִּי אִם־תִּגְאַל גְּאָל וְאִם־לֹא יִגְאַל הַגִּידָה לִּי ואדע [וְאֵדְעָה] כִּי אֵין זוּלָתְךָ לִגְאוֹל וְאָנֹכִי אַחֲרֶיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֶגְאָל׃

verses.english: Boaz said, “On the day you acquire the field from Naomi’s hand, you also acquire from Ruth the Moabite, the dead man’s wife, to raise up the dead man’s name upon his inheritance.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּעַז בְּיוֹם־קְנוֹתְךָ הַשָּׂדֶה מִיַּד נָעֳמִי וּמֵאֵת רוּת הַמּוֹאֲבִיָּה אֵשֶׁת־הַמֵּת קניתי [קָנִיתָה] לְהָקִים שֵׁם־הַמֵּת עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: The redeeming kinsman said, “I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I ruin my inheritance. Redeem for yourself my right of redemption, for I cannot redeem it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגֹּאֵל לֹא אוּכַל לגאול־[לִגְאָל־] לִי פֶּן־אַשְׁחִית אֶת־נַחֲלָתִי גְּאַל־לְךָ אַתָּה אֶת־גְּאֻלָּתִי כִּי לֹא־אוּכַל לִגְאֹל׃

verses.english: This was the practice formerly in Israel concerning redemption and exchange, to confirm every matter: a man removed his sandal and gave it to his neighbor. This was the attestation in Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְזֹאת לְפָנִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־הַגְּאוּלָּה וְעַל־הַתְּמוּרָה לְקַיֵּם כָּל־דָּבָר שָׁלַף אִישׁ נַעֲלוֹ וְנָתַן לְרֵעֵהוּ וְזֹאת הַתְּעוּדָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The redeeming kinsman said to Boaz, “Acquire it for yourself.” He removed his sandal.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַגֹּאֵל לְבֹעַז קְנֵה־לָךְ וַיִּשְׁלֹף נַעֲלוֹ׃

verses.english: Boaz said to the elders and all the people, “You are witnesses today that I have acquired from Naomi’s hand everything that belonged to Elimelech and everything that belonged to Chilion and Mahlon.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר בֹּעַז לַזְּקֵנִים וְכָל־הָעָם עֵדִים אַתֶּם הַיּוֹם כִּי קָנִיתִי אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לֶאֱלִימֶלֶךְ וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לְכִלְיוֹן וּמַחְלוֹן מִיַּד נָעֳמִי׃

verses.english: I have also acquired Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon’s wife, as my wife, to raise up the dead man’s name upon his inheritance, so that the dead man’s name will not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place. You are witnesses today.”
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶת־רוּת הַמֹּאֲבִיָּה אֵשֶׁת מַחְלוֹן קָנִיתִי לִי לְאִשָּׁה לְהָקִים שֵׁם־הַמֵּת עַל־נַחֲלָתוֹ וְלֹא־יִכָּרֵת שֵׁם־הַמֵּת מֵעִם אֶחָיו וּמִשַּׁעַר מְקוֹמוֹ עֵדִים אַתֶּם הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: All the people at the gate and the elders said, “We are witnesses. May YHWH make the woman entering your house like Rachel and Leah, who together built Israel’s house. May you act worthily in Ephrathah and make a name in Bethlehem.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בַּשַּׁעַר וְהַזְּקֵנִים עֵדִים יִתֵּן יְהוָה אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה הַבָּאָה אֶל־בֵּיתֶךָ כְּרָחֵל וּכְלֵאָה אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ שְׁתֵּיהֶם אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וַעֲשֵׂה־חַיִל בְּאֶפְרָתָה וּקְרָא־שֵׁם בְּבֵית לָחֶם׃

verses.english: May your house be like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, through the offspring YHWH will give you from this young woman.”
verses.hebrew: וִיהִי בֵיתְךָ כְּבֵית פֶּרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָה תָמָר לִיהוּדָה מִן־הַזֶּרַע אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּן יְהוָה לְךָ מִן־הַנַּעֲרָה הַזֹּאת׃

verses.english: Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. He went in to her, and YHWH gave her conception, and she bore a son.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח בֹּעַז אֶת־רוּת וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה לָהּ הֵרָיוֹן וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן׃

verses.english: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be YHWH, who has not left you without a redeeming kinsman today. May his name be called in Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמַרְנָה הַנָּשִׁים אֶל־נָעֳמִי בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא הִשְׁבִּית לָךְ גֹּאֵל הַיּוֹם וְיִקָּרֵא שְׁמוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He shall be to you a restorer of life and a sustainer of your old age, for your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has borne him.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה לָךְ לְמֵשִׁיב נֶפֶשׁ וּלְכַלְכֵּל אֶת־שֵׂיבָתֵךְ כִּי כַלָּתֵךְ אֲ‍שֶׁר־אֲהֵבַתֶךְ יְלָדַתּוּ אֲשֶׁר־הִיא טוֹבָה לָךְ מִשִּׁבְעָה בָּנִים׃

verses.english: Naomi took the child, placed him in her bosom, and became his nurse.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח נָעֳמִי אֶת־הַיֶּלֶד וַתְּשִׁתֵהוּ בְחֵיקָהּ וַתְּהִי־לוֹ לְאֹמֶנֶת׃

verses.english: The neighboring women gave him a name, saying, “A son has been born to Naomi.” They called his name Obed. He was the father of Jesse, the father of David.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרֶאנָה לוֹ הַשְּׁכֵנוֹת שֵׁם לֵאמֹר יֻלַּד־בֵּן לְנָעֳמִי וַתִּקְרֶאנָה שְׁמוֹ עוֹבֵד הוּא אֲבִי־יִשַׁי אֲבִי דָוִד׃

verses.english: These are the generations of Perez: Perez begat Hezron,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תּוֹלְדוֹת פָּרֶץ פֶּרֶץ הוֹלִיד אֶת־חֶצְרוֹן׃

verses.english: Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
verses.hebrew: וְחֶצְרוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת־רָם וְרָם הוֹלִיד אֶת־עַמִּינָדָב׃

verses.english: Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmah,
verses.hebrew: וְעַמִּינָדָב הוֹלִיד אֶת־נַחְשׁוֹן וְנַחְשׁוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת־שַׂלְמָה׃

verses.english: Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂלְמוֹן הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֹּעַז וּבֹעַז הוֹלִיד אֶת־עוֹבֵד׃

verses.english: Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
verses.hebrew: וְעֹבֵד הוֹלִיד אֶת־יִשָׁי וְיִשַׁי הוֹלִיד אֶת־דָּוִד׃
